_doc: Pearl (Diamond/Pearl US) overworld movement action codes 0x00-0x68 (u16 code,u16 count pairs ending 0xFE, ApplyMovement 0x5E) mapped to Black 2 (US) ActorCmdExec Move codes. Pearl table: pokediamond arm9/asm/unk_02058EE8.s UNK_020F6440 (105 entries; sub_0205ADDC asserts code < 0x69), handlers in arm9/asm/unk_0205AD98.s; step-0 args (dir, units/frame, frames, anim) read from the asm. Names: pokeplatinum generated/movement_actions.txt; Platinum src/unk_020EDBAC.c gMovementActionFuncs + src/unk_020655F4.c have identical semantics/params for 0x00-0x68 (Platinum only appends 0x69-0x99). Black 2: pokebw2 build/b2_us/build/arm9_ov036.bin, table ACTOR_ACTION_COMMAND_TABLES at 0x021ccae8 (= 0x021cca50 + 38 words; 193 entries, 0-192), handlers disassembled from build/b2_us/delinks/src/ov036/fldmmdl_acmd.o. Both fields run at 30 fps (pokediamond main.c double VBlank wait; pokebw2 fieldmap.c GCTX_HIDChangeFPS(30)); a tile = 16 units, frames/tile identical in both. uses = Move lines in work/pearl/scripts/*.txt (2940 lines, 126 files); count_sum = sum of counts. b2 = code to emit (a substitute when exact is false). exact = same action and same timing, ignoring sprite-anim ids and the 1-frame walk-in-place hold.
